name: Close a door or drawer
description: Close an annotated articulated door or drawer after access or to satisfy a closed-state goal.
requires: The named part has an annotated handle and closed joint target.
The gripper is free for handle manipulation.
A collision-free pose for reaching and moving the handle can be found at execution time.

outcomes.success: The part reaches its annotated closed joint target within the skill's tolerance.
outcomes.failure: The handle cannot be reached or grasped, or the part does not reach the closed target.

verifier.evidence: The function checks the measured joint value against the annotated closed target.

connections.when: The part is the microwave door and configured food is inside the cavity.
